questions.question: You are Riya / Rahul of 12, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad. Write a letter to the Municipal Commissioner complaining about potholes on the main road of your area. (100-120 words)
answer_steps: Format: sender's address, date, The Municipal Commissioner, AMC, Ahmedabad; Subject: Dangerous potholes on the main road of Navrangpura; Sir/Madam.
Para 1: introduce yourself as a resident; state the purpose.
Para 2: deep potholes after the monsoon; accidents to two-wheelers; traffic jams; water logging and mosquitoes.
Para 3: request urgent repair before the festival season; thank and hope for prompt action.
Close: Yours faithfully, signature, Riya.
